hooks.name: Image Budget Check
hooks.description: Warn if a new image in public/images is over 200 KB or not WebP/AVIF.

action.command: node -e "const i=require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8');const d=JSON.parse(i);const f=d.file||'';if(!f)process.exit(0);const path=require('path');const ext=path.extname(f).toLowerCase();if(!['.webp','.avif'].includes(ext)){console.error('IMAGE-BUDGET: \"'+f+'\" is not WebP or AVIF. Convert before committing.');process.exit(1);}const bytes=require('fs').statSync(f).size;const kb=Math.round(bytes/1024);if(bytes>200*1024){console.error('IMAGE-BUDGET: \"'+f+'\" is '+kb+' KB — exceeds 200 KB limit.');process.exit(1);}console.log('IMAGE-BUDGET: \"'+f+'\" is '+kb+' KB — OK.');"
